Name: Gifts from Sandy - Oasis Supplies
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Earn rewards and gifts by visiting and chatting with your desert friend, including useful items and unique things found only in the hot sands of Calico.

Coffee, coconut, and very useful seeds, plus other exclusive gifts delivered directly to your mailbox.

Enjoy the wonders of the desert and come explore even more with your support friend for anything you need to buy provided she sells it, of course.

[b][size=4]✨ Features[/size][/b]

✔ Unique gifts for every friendship level
✔ Character-themed rewards
✔ Better and better gifts with each new level
✔ Fully lore-friendly gift selections
✔ Compatible with existing saves
✔ Gifts are reset when the mod is updated.
